name: opencli-plugin-google-suggest
description: opencli plugin: Google Suggest with optional --move-cursor sweep (overrides google suggest)

scripts.build: npx esbuild src/suggest-lib.ts --outfile=suggest-lib.js --format=esm --platform=node && npx esbuild src/suggest.ts --bundle --outfile=suggest.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external
